pages.text: $(o)When the sun sinks and the stars awaken,$(br)those who once kept watch walk again.$(br)Hooded, their lanterns dark, they wander the night,$(br)still clutching the words they failed to guard.$(br2)Take the first page back from the fallen,$(br)and the road to the light will open.$()
Keep this Almanac with you. A recovered page, once read, becomes part of it and reveals the next step of the journey.
